review.description: Reviewed maintain-flow-contracts S3/S4/S5 against main: the two exact-source Python suite jobs run concurrently and both gate the runtime, isolated performance and package job; local make ci retains every check. Stable flow IDs, dependency ownership and pinned adoption remain unchanged.
review.implementation: Reviewed scoped exact-source comparison and forced fixture mode. The two Python matrix jobs run complete suites, and runtime verification excludes only those required suites. The verify job uses !cancelled() and executes a success-only dependency guard before checkout, preserving workflow cancellation. Each ordinary Python target checks records for its exact comparison before executing the long suite; reviewed bootstrap targets validate registries without inventing a comparison. Runtime and complete local graphs retain all other checks and package publication boundaries.
review.tests: Four new test methods assert exact-source fixture job dependencies, execute the actual shell guard for success and unsuccessful or unavailable results, reject wrong comparisons before dispatch and package publication, and compare actual ordinary/bootstrap Make graph multisets. Failed admission prevents the Python suite even under parallel and keep-going flags. Five focused controls passed19.335s on the accepted-base source, to which this proposal has returned byte-for-byte after rejecting the sharding dependency. Full fresh54tooling/437specification suite execution, all other catalog gates and separate local CI remain required. No sharding behavior or unmerged dependency is retained.
